collectors.titleDetails: (15 total Queries, 15 of them unique across 1 Connection)

queries.sql: SELECT SUM(DATEDIFF(check_out_date, check_in_date)) AS total_nights FROM reservations WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND check_in_date <= '2026-09-23' AND check_out_date >= '2026-08-25'

SELECT DATE(check_in_date) AS tanggal, SUM(total_price) AS total FROM reservations WHERE check_in_date >= '2026-08-25' AND check_in_date <= '2026-09-23' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY DATE(check_in_date) ORDER BY tanggal ASC

SELECT DATE(check_in_date) AS tanggal, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_reservasi FROM reservations WHERE check_in_date >= '2026-08-25' AND check_in_date <= '2026-09-23' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY DATE(check_in_date) ORDER BY tanggal ASC

SELECT ro.room_number, ro.floor, rt.name AS type_name, COUNT(rr.id) AS total_bookings FROM reservation_rooms rr JOIN reservations r ON r.id = rr.reservation_id JOIN rooms ro ON ro.id = rr.room_id LEFT JOIN room_types rt ON rt.id = ro.room_type_id WHERE r.check_in_date >= '2026-08-25' AND r.check_in_date <= '2026-09-23' AND r.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY rr.room_id ORDER BY total_bookings DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT i.name, i.unit, SUM(sd.quantity_approved) AS total_qty FROM sr_details sd JOIN items i ON i.id = sd.item_id JOIN store_requisitions sr ON sr.id = sd.sr_id WHERE sr.requested_date >= '2026-08-25' AND sr.requested_date <= '2026-09-23' AND sr.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY sd.item_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS total_sr FROM store_requisitions WHERE requested_date >= '2026-08-25' AND requested_date <= '2026-09-23' GROUP BY department ORDER BY total_sr DESC
